patients.summary: Healthy agricultural pest control technician who joined in 2023 and was last seen for a physical in September 2024. After that he had two outside organophosphate poisonings (ED 2025, ICU 2026) that reach the practice only as late records and portal messages.

documents.title: New Patient Scheduling
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is a 31 y/o man looking for a primary doctor; has not had one since his old family practice. Medicaid, card info taken and eligibility verified. No acute issues, just wants a checkup. Booked new patient physical 8/22 at 8:40. Asked him to come fasting for labs and to bring any vaccine records he has. Records release form for his prior family practice sent by email.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
31 y/o man, new to the practice. Last regular care was with a family practice through his early twenties; nothing since. Feels well. No meds, no supplements. No drug allergies.

PMH: none.
PSH: tonsils out as a kid, around age 8.
FH: dad has type 2 diabetes. Mom has high blood pressure. Nothing else he knows of.
Social: works for a pest control outfit that services farms, mixing and spraying for the growing season, lighter work in winter. Never smoked, never vaped. Drinks rarely, maybe a beer or two a month. No drugs.

ROS: negative across the board. No chest pain, breathing trouble, GI or urinary complaints, no headaches, mood fine.
PHQ-2: 0.

Exam: vitals in flowsheet. Well appearing. HEENT: tonsillar fossae empty, oropharynx clear, TMs normal. Neck supple, no nodes, thyroid not enlarged. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender, no organomegaly. Skin: no rashes. Extremities without edema. Neuro grossly intact.

A/P: healthy adult, establishing care.
- Screening: CBC, CMP, lipids, A1c (dad's diabetes), one-time HIV and hep C. Drawn today.
- Tdap given today; he has no record of one as an adult.
- Asked what he works with. Says the crew uses respirators and gloves when spraying and the company runs safety training each spring. Encouraged him to keep using the gear.
- Flu and COVID once the fall supply is in. Annual physical next summer.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Ramon, everything from Tuesday came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver function, cholesterol, sugar and A1c all fine. HIV and hepatitis C screens negative. Nothing to do except come back for the vaccines this fall. Good to meet you.

documents.title: Prior Family Practice Records
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Records received by fax from his prior family practice, 38 pages, covering 1996 through 2014.

Contents: well-child and adolescent visits; childhood immunization series complete; tonsillectomy in spring 2000, recovered without problems; sports physicals in his teens, normal. Last visit 2014, an adult physical with normal exam. No chronic problems, no medications, no drug allergies listed.

Scanned to chart and routed to PCP.

documents.title: Nurse Visit: Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In after work for flu and COVID. Feeling well, no fever, no reactions to past vaccines. Flu vaccine to left deltoid, COVID to right deltoid. VIS given. Observed 15 minutes, no reaction. Advised acetaminophen if the arm aches.

documents.title: Vaccine Record
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, my job is doing paperwork before the season starts and they want proof of my tetanus shot. Can you send me something I can print? Thanks

documents.title: RE: Vaccine Record
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Ramon, your immunization record is attached as a PDF. It shows the Tdap from last August along with your fall flu and COVID shots. Let us know if your employer needs a different form.

documents.title: Annual Physical Due
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Ramon, it's been about a year since your last physical. We have you down for August 30 at 8:00. Please come fasting. Reply here or call if that time no longer works.

documents.title: Missed Appointment Follow-up
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Called pt re: no-show 8/30. He says the crew got called out early that morning and he forgot to call. Rebooked physical for 9/27 at 7:40, first slot, so he can get to a job site after. Fasting reminder given.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam. 32 y/o, well. Busy season winding down. No complaints today. No ER or urgent care visits this year. Still no meds. No drug allergies.

Social unchanged: never smoker, rare beer, works farm pest control. Uses respirator and gloves on the job per him.
FH: father T2DM, mother HTN.
PHQ-2 0.

Exam: vitals reviewed. Up a kilo from last year. Comfortable. Eyes, ears, throat normal. No lymphadenopathy. Heart RRR without murmur. Lungs clear bilaterally. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin clear. No edema. Normal gait and strength.

A/P: healthy 32 y/o male.
- CMP, lipids, A1c today given family history.
- Flu shot given. COVID update is optional for him this year; he passed.
- Return 1 yr, sooner if needed.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Ramon, your labs from Friday are all within the normal range, A1c included, so no sign of diabetes. See you next year for your physical.
